1.name: Censuring Strike
1.description: Censure your target with a violent strike, dealing 100% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 1 (L1) to 4 (L8) Physical Damage, and decreasing their Casting Speed by 20% for 30 seconds.

1.name: Distress
1.description: Distress your target, dealing 3 (L1) to 5 (L4) Magic Damage, increasing your Threat against them by 25, and decreasing their magic resistance by 2 for 30 seconds.
1.valuesSummary: 3–5 Magic dmg (L1–L4) · −25 Threat against them · −2 decreasing their magic resistance

1.name: Polar Alignment: North
1.description: Magically align yourself, orienting you toward the North Pole.

1.name: Taunt
1.description: Taunt your target, drawing their attention.

2.name: Aura of Resistance
2.description: Envelop your party in a warding aura, reducing their Spell Damage received by 5% and increasing their Cold, Fire, Corruption, Holy, and Magic Resistance by 2 (L1) to 30 (L60). This ability persists until canceled."

3.name: Kick
3.description: Swiftly kick your target, interrupting their casting and preventing them from casting spells from the same school of magic for 2 seconds.

3.name: Minor Spellshield
3.description: Encircle yourself with a magical shield, increasing your maximum Health by 10, Armor Calss by 5, and Magic Resistance by 5 for 1 hour.

3.name: Reflecting Bash
3.description: Fiercely bash your target with a shield, interrupting their casting, dealing Magic Damage equal to the Mana cost of the interrupted spell, and preventing them from casting spells from the same school of magic for 4 seconds. This ability requires a shield."

4.name: Arcane Aegis
4.description: Surround yourself with an arcane aegis, granting you immunity to spell damage for 15 seconds. This spell can be used while stunned, incapacitated, or feared. This spell inflicts Exhausted Soul upon expiration, preventing the application of immunity effects for 30 seconds."

4.name: Spell Ward
4.description: Shield your target with a spell ward, absorbing 25 Spell Damage received for 15 seconds.

5.name: Arcane Tyrant
5.description: Embody tyranny over the arcane, increasing your Strength by 2 (L1) to 10 (L50) and Magic Resistance by 5 (L1) to 15 (L50), and granting you the ability to see invisible entities and magical effects when considering targets for 1 hour.

5.name: Interdiction
5.description: Condemn your target, increasing your Threat against them by 40 and incapacitating them for 30 seconds. This spell is removed by damage.

6.name: Silence
6.description: Silence your target, preventing them from casting spells for 6 seconds.

6.name: Ward of Suspicion
6.description: Encase yourself in a ward of suspicion, absorbing 25 damage received for 15 seconds. Additionally, when an attacker breaks the ward, their Attack Speed is decreased by 10% for 15 seconds.

7.name: Fire Protection
7.description: Ward yourself against heat, increasing your Fire Resistance by 5 for 1 hour.

8.name: Dominate the Mind
8.description: Exert dominion over your target, forcing them to fight alongside you for 1 minute. This ability has no effect on targets over level 52. This ability is moderately difficult to resist.

8.name: Pillage Mana
8.description: Pillage the mind of your target, draining 20 Mana and distributing 25% of the amount drained to each party member. Additionally, when this spell successfully lands on the target, its Mana cost is refunded.

8.name: Sense Magic
8.description: Glaze the eyes of your target with a magical coating, granting them the ability to see magical effects when considering targets for 1 hour.

9.name: Dispel Magic
9.description: Dispel magic from your target, removing one harmful effect.

10.name: Purifying Blow
10.description: Unleash a purifying blow upon your target, dealing 150% Weapon Ratio Damage plus 2 (L10) to 10 (L20) Magic Damage, increasing your Threat against them by 30 (L1) to 300 (L60), and granting you a chance to remove one beneficial effect from them. Additionally, if the target is afflicted by any spell in the Distress line, the purge effect is guaranteed.
